Class ResourcePreviewCanvasBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourcePreviewCanvasBuilder
public class ResourcePreviewCanvasBuilder extends Object
Cartographic Preview Canvas Controller and View Renderer for Resource Distribution.

Extracted from ResourceDistributionPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Responsible for:

  • Interactive pan and multi-resolution zoom (\( 0.5\times \dots 20.0\times \)) over equirectangular projections.
  • Relief hillshading computation: $$\text{Hillshade} = \frac{0.5 \cdot \Delta\text{Lng} + 0.5 \cdot \Delta\text{Lat} + 0.707}{\sqrt{\Delta\text{Lng}^2 + \Delta\text{Lat}^2 + 1.0}}$$
  • Dynamic rendering across 16 thematic cartographic layers: Biomes, Hydrography, 10 Geological Tensors, Thermal flux, Seismic hazard, and Aridity index.
  • High-contrast localized legend generation and color-swatch rendering.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2

Silvere Martin-Michiellot
